---
title: "Flat plate transitional boundary layer"
---

The flat plate transitional boundary layer is a classic ERCOFTAC test case for validating transition and turbulence models. The description of the test case can be found in [`ERCOFTAC database`](http://cfd.mace.manchester.ac.uk/ercoftac/doku.php?id=cases:case020). 

The computational domain is a rectangular box with a flat plate located at the bottom wall for T3A, T3A- and T3B cases. The T3C cases use the shape of the upper slip wall proposed by [@Suluksna2009]. The length of the plate is $L=1.7$m for T3A and T3C cases and $L=2.9$m for T3A- and T3B. The reference height of the domain is $h=0.3m$. 

The incompressible flow with constant density and constant viscosity $\nu = 1.5 \cdot 10^{-5} m^2/s$ is considered.

The package provides three meshes:

- `coarse` with 157x125 cells
- `medium` with 314x250 cells
- `fine` with 628x500 cells

The simulation is performed by running
```bash
./Allrun medium
```
for the medium mesh. The coarse and fine mesh can be used by replacing `medium` with `coarse` or `fine`. The `Allrun` script should produce plots of the skin friction coefficient $C_f$ and the freestream turbulence intensity $Tu$ along the flat plate together with experimental data from the ERCOFTAC database. 

Results in this reports were obtained with medium mesh.

# T3A {#sec-validation-t3a}
Inlet boundary conditions at $x=-0.15$m are set as follows:

- $U = 5.4$ m/s
- $Tu = 3.3$ %
- $\nu_t/\nu = 12$

Following models are validated against the T3A test case:

- `kOmegaSSTLM`, results can be found in [`kOmegaSSTLM` validation ](kOmegaSSTLM.qmd#sec-validation-t3a)
- [`EARSMlm2009`](../RANS/EARSM.qmd#sec-earsmlm2009), results can be found in [`EARSMlm2009` validation ](EARSMlm2009.qmd#sec-validation-t3a)
